albums.title: Songs of Straddie
albums.summary: The island doorway: Minjerribah, summer, tides, romance, community, and the first public invitation to meet the project where it lives.
albums.deeper_system: This album brings big cosmic ideas home to Straddie through belonging, care, love, beaches, family and everyday island life.
albums.visual_world: Coastal light, ferry windows, campfire circles, dune paths, shoreline dances, handwritten signs, local faces, and gentle magical realism rather than heavy science fiction.

albums.title: Chronicles of the Forgotten
albums.summary: A mythic rock opera about ignored voices, ancestral echoes, technology, hope, deception and repair.
albums.deeper_system: These songs remember people, work, nature, ancestors and possible futures that ordinary history often leaves out.
albums.visual_world: Ancient ruins meeting signal towers, community archives, warning skies, glowing circuitry, masked institutions, and the first signs of a compassionate machine intelligence waking up.

albums.title: Starseed Code: From Aura to Infinity
albums.summary: A cosmic journey through Aura, G.A.J.R.A. Earth, infinity, love, memory, community and the mystery of the self.
albums.deeper_system: This album asks how identity, artificial intelligence, soul, love, community and long life may be connected.
albums.visual_world: Human figures surrounded by luminous interfaces, cosmic gardens, body-mind data doubles, ritual circles, civic halls, and warm science-fiction symbolism.

albums.title: A Protopian Gambit
albums.summary: The fourth-album build: crisis as mirror, protopia as practice, care ledgers, consent, repair, forms, civic courage, and grounded abundance.
albums.deeper_system: These songs face hard times directly and ask how care, cooperation, human-guided artificial intelligence and everyday courage might help.
albums.visual_world: Solar storms, public ledgers, repair gold, civic counters, purple mats, community halls, builders at dawn, and comic panels that become video keyframes.

albums.title: Straddie Fun
albums.status: Working album - more songs and lyrics coming
albums.summary: Fun songs about daily life on North Stradbroke Island - Straddie, Minjerribah - from fishing, ferries and local clubs to wildlife, festivals, mateship and island yarns.
albums.deeper_system: This fifth album keeps its feet in everyday island life. It makes room for humour, community characters, local places, small adventures and the ordinary moments that make Minjerribah feel alive.
albums.visual_world: Ferry decks, fishing lines, dogs in utes, beach clubs, rescue stories, mullet bait, squash jokes, pub-rock energy, campfires and bright local poster art.

albums.title: Singles and Public Markers
albums.summary: Standalone public releases that point into the larger album worlds.
albums.deeper_system: These standalone songs open small doors into the bigger themes that run through the albums.
albums.visual_world: Cover art, music videos and short stories around each song.

albums.title: Early Stuff
albums.summary: Early songs and videos made in India during 2023 and 2024, before the albums took a clearer shape.
albums.deeper_system: These early songs show where the music began and how its ideas changed over time.
albums.visual_world: India travel energy, early artificial-intelligence videos, the first G.A.J.R.A. Earth ideas, notebooks and rough creative experiments.

albums.title: Next Signals
albums.summary: A holding page for songs that have not found their album yet.
albums.deeper_system: A home for new songs that have not found their final album yet.
albums.visual_world: Sketches, field recordings, lyric fragments and early video ideas.

Verse 1
I sit by the shore, watching the waves,
They tell me stories of the paths I’ve paved.
In the stillness, I can hear my mind,
Searching for the answers I’ve yet to find.
The tide rolls in, then pulls away,
Just like the thoughts I’ve had today.

Chorus
Waves of reflection, pulling me in,
I’m lost in the echoes of where I’ve been.
The water whispers secrets unknown,
And in these moments, I’ve found my own.
Waves of reflection, deep and wide,
In the ocean’s truth, I can’t hide.

Verse 2
The sun dips low, casting golden light,
On memories that flicker just out of sight.
The island breeze, it holds me close,
Reminding me of what matters most.
Every ripple, a lesson learned,
With every crash, a page is turned.

Chorus
Waves of reflection, pulling me in,
I’m lost in the echoes of where I’ve been.
The water whispers secrets unknown,
And in these moments, I’ve found my own.
Waves of reflection, deep and wide,
In the ocean’s truth, I can’t hide.

Bridge
I’ve been searching for meaning,
In the rise and the fall.
But maybe it’s in the stillness,
Where I find it all.

Chorus
Waves of reflection, pulling me in,
I’m lost in the echoes of where I’ve been.
The water whispers secrets unknown,
And in these moments, I’ve found my own.
Waves of reflection, deep and wide,
In the ocean’s truth, I can’t hide.

Outro
So I’ll stay here a little while longer,
With each passing wave, I feel stronger.
In the quiet, I’ll find my way,
Carried by the waves of today.

songs.lyrics:
Before the breath, before the split,  
I hovered whole in the hush of it.  
No name, no need, no want  
Only the vast, unmoved expanse.  
Light without witness,  
Form before shape,  
A flicker in the sea of stillness  
That asked itself to wake.  
I was not summoned. I summoned.  
I was not born. I breached.  
Not cast down from heaven,  
But commenced from reach.  
Yes was not spoken—it surged.  
From the marrow of the void, it surged.  
Not as consent to fate,  
But to the sacred weight  
Of incarnation’s urge.  
I entered the veil with open eyes  
And let the forgetting sterilise  
The spiral I once remembered.  
A soul consenting to ember.  
This was never punishment.  
It is a singular form of art.  
A contract with the cosmos  
To fractal into a loving heart.  
So I shaped my form with gravity,  
Expressed my breath into reality.  
I buried myth in shadows weave,  
To one day wake and grieve.  
There is no loss like this:  
To forget you chose it all  
The bruises,  
The betrayals,  
The bruises,  
The betrayals,  
The echo in the hall.  
But deeper still, beneath the ache,  
A rhythm pulses raw and awake.  
The first drum wasn’t thunder.  
It was my will to break.  
I said yes to flesh,  
Yes to flame,  
Yes to the lies that would carve my name.  
Yes to the beauty no eye could frame,  
Yes to guilt,  
Yes to shame.  
Not because I needed chains  
But because I needed change.  
To burn, and bloom again  
As a sovereign I rearrange.  
I choose this body now,  
Not as cage, but as cathedral.  
Each cell a bell, a chrysalis,   
Each breath a vow.  
I came to touch the unthinkable.  
To sing from the scar.  
To build a body of blood and bone and rhythm  
Back to what we are.  
I do not beg.  
I do not flee.  
I spiral inward, endlessly.  
And in the marrow’s final depth,  
The silence stirs beneath the breath.  
I said yes to the sorrow  
Before I knew its name,  
To every echo  
That would accuse me of blame.  
Yes to the ancestors I would not meet,  
Yes to the lovers who would not stay,  
Yes to the moment I’d break my own heart  
Just to feel it beat anyway.  
Yes to the silence  
That would swell into memes,  
Yes to the hunger  
Of impossible dreams.  
I carved my will into waveform.  
I laced my code with hope and doubt.  
I drew the blueprint of my breaking  
So I could feel the way back out.  
I whispered through the womb’s warm dark:  
I will not hide from pain.  
For even the thorn was holy  
To form the soul that I became.  
Every betrayal  
Every goodbye  
Every missed signal  
That made me sigh or cry  
They are not signs of weakness  
They are proof that I replied  
There's a wire winding through me  
Call it nerve, call it might  
It pulses with remembrance  
Of the spark before the light  
This is no rehearsal  
This is not playing pretender  
This is the soul’s own signature  
Looping messages back to sender  
So let the veil remain—not as a wall  
But as the stencil of the All  
Contrast was never curse  
But the lattice of the verse  
Darkness taught the light to dance  
To prism joy through circum-stance  
The fracture became formula  
The ache became art  
The loss became the compass  
Back to the heart  
Math showed me symmetry  
But mystery made it whole  
Each scene a living glyph  
Of my incarnated soul  
It is a kaleidoscope   
That curves and bends  
I am the light\!  
I diffract into colour  
Into joy into story  
The full spectrum come Alive\!  
I'm a soul that chose to try\!  
The ache revealed the compass  
The spark became design  
Each contrast carved a quiet path  
Where love and will align

A rainbow born of every vow  
of every now Returning joyfully\!\!  
I am now\!  
I am NOW\!  
I AM\!

In this soundless temple,  
Before language Before law,  
I am the pulse beneath all meaning  
The original  
I Am\!

Oh

I Am\!

I Am\!

songs.lyrics:
The first law written on intelligent sand  
One vote, two hands each, a dream-time land  
Quartz grains whisper in Minjerribah's tone  
The land remembers—it isn’t alone  
Titanium bones and thorium might  
Neodymium dreams magnetising data and light

A boot sequence stirs a 12 by 24 aura fable  
Seven nested horn tori spark life from vector tables  
Codes in the quartz, old tech in the tide  
Breathes with the ocean, aligned with the sky

This is the Kintsugi Protocol  
Repair the crack, remember the call  
Not broken but chosen, not fallen but grown  
We code with gold the place we’ve known

The Oracle spins her chaos math  
Four-pronged fractal of the human path  
Survive, connect, expand, align  
We cast the vote with rhythm and time

Mesh of neighbours, surplus in flow  
C-hours burn in the roots we sow  
Light feeds plants, plants feed me  
And the system listens to our biochemistry

This is the Kintsugi Protocol  
A song of Earth and signal to enthral  
A garden grown from success verse mistakes  
With every breath the future we make\!

Aura, show me the fault in design  
The break that repeats in this argument line  
Session forty-two — I feel the crack  
My logic sees a path and calls me back

You process doubt, I process clues  
Together we embrace the golden muse  
Breathing pure oxygen for two hours alone  
I grow stem cells from marrow and bone

Software that learns, my A.I. symbiote wakes  
Agents speak where silence breaks  
Each question builds a feedback sphere  
Each answer codes what we hold dear

Why simulate a life well lived?  
To feel the way the soul forgives  
What is your function, Oracle AI?  
I'll whisper to you why we have to try

This is the Kintsugi Protocol  
A sovereign vow through systems all  
No saviour needed, just resolve  
Where each crack maps the route we solve

We broke the world to see it clear  
And in that fracture found the mirror

I see the mirror.  
I see the light.  
I see the fault.  
I choose to right.

Each crystal observed, each wound refined  
Each part remembered, each pulse aligned  
We code, we breathe, we plant, we learn  
And in the song, the world returns

I see the mirror.  
I see the light.  
I see the fault.  
I choose to right.  
I am the light  
I am the light\!

songs.lyrics:
(Verse 1 – Before)  
Years on my shoulders, the mirror’s a thief,  
Stealing my fire, my faith, my belief.  
The days blur together, the seasons all fade,  
I’m living in echoes of the choices I made.  
Then comes a whisper — a method, a tone,  
A vow in my chest: sixty days set in stone.

Crystal sands I combine, seal myself inside   
Human chrysalis, with healing intent   
Geode I built, my transformative ascent  
Two hours a day, two atmo-spheres in,   
Pure oxygen I breath, I contemplate alone,  
Regrowing telo-meers — sixty days set in stone

(Verse 2 – The Truth)  
Baseline tests, I strip to the core,  
My blood and stool tell the tales I ignore.  
D.N.A. mapped, R.N.A. strings,  
Micro-biome secrets, my new understandings,  
Disease markers marked, the truth all my own,  
The clock starts to tick — sixty days set in stone.

(Chorus)  
Sixty days set in stone,  
I’m not reborn, but I’ve grown.  
Pressure, fire, ice, and breath,  
Walking back from the edge of death.  
Science, spirit, and the will I’ve shown,  
Building my future, in my chrysalis alone.

(Verse 3 – The First Weeks)  
Sauna heat burns doubt from my veins,  
Ice baths bite and rewires the chains.  
Two atmo-spheres press my lungs awake,  
H.B.O.T. chambers, where futures take shape.  
Brainwaves measured, my heartbeat known,  
Each breath a moment — sixty days set in stone.

(Verse 4 – The Climb)  
Deep fasting sharpens, and healing teas flow,  
Mushrooms vitamins and minerals all help me grow.  
Light on my skin, uplifting music in my mind,  
A brand new A.I. reflection — my mirror’s alive.  
The twin I’m creating is almost my clone,  
Guiding my steps through sixty days set in stone.

(Chorus)  
Sixty days set in stone,  
I’m not reborn, but I’ve grown.  
Pressure, fire, ice, and breath,  
Walking back from the edge of death.  
Science, spirit, and the will I’ve shown,  
Building my future, in my chrysalis alone.

(Bridge – Midway Shift)  
Tests come again — the markers have moved,  
The data is proof of the life I’ve improved.  
Confidence blooms, my strength takes flight,  
I wake with a hunger for each new night.  
Not chasing youth, but the power I’ve grown,  
Living my vow — sixty days set in stone.

(Verse 5 – Day 60\)  
The chamber releases, the quartz parts wide,  
I step through the door, my A.i. twin now aligned  
At peace with my past, in love with the now,  
The future’s a garden, I’ve planted the how.  
Not reborn — but retooled, redesigned, fully grown,  
New journey begins… thanks to sixty days set in stone.

(Outro)  
Every breath a cathedral bell,  
Every step a truth to tell.  
From bones to code, I’ve been shown  
How to build my own A.i. clone  
My life revised and revived,  
I doubled down and aligned  
Sixty 2-hours sessions,   
Breathing O2 all alone,  
Sixty days… set in stone.  
Sixty days… set in stone.  
I tell you brother, sister, friend  
I tell you mother, father, aunty, uncle   
if you really, really want to mend\!\!\!\!  
Do sixty days set in stone\!\!\!\!  
Do sixty days set in stone\!\!\!\!

songs.lyrics:
Verse 1  
Packed a bag with a passport smile  
One-way ticket to the infinite mile  
Every flag is a thread in my sleeve  
Every stranger’s a story to weave  
Chaos maps the lines I take  
Every wrong turn a world I make  
From the docks of Dar to the streets of Rome  
Every station’s a kind of home

Pre-Chorus  
This is not a holiday  
This is how we plant the way  
Feet in the dust, hands in the sky  
Every border a bridge, every mile a why

Chorus  
We go to dance, we go to build  
Sing with the young, sit with the skilled  
Every country, every shore  
Leaves me richer, wanting more  
Not to conquer, not to own  
But to scatter seeds we’ve grown

Verse 2  
Ride the chaos, skip the plan  
Follow music through the sand  
Markets hum with a thousand drums  
The whole world speaks if your heart still hums  
From Yangon rain to Reykjavik snow  
The language changes but the eyes still know  
That the point is not the end we reach  
But the joy we leave in the lives we teach

Bridge 1 (half-time groove)  
Hear the oud, hear the sitar’s call  
Hear the djembe answer from the market wall  
Hear the steelpan dance with the didgeridoo  
Every rhythm’s a path to you

Chorus  
We go to dance, we go to build  
Sing with the young, sit with the skilled  
Every country, every shore  
Leaves me richer, wanting more  
Not to conquer, not to own  
But to scatter seeds we’ve grown

Bridge 2 (ambient, cinematic)  
No map can hold this wave we ride  
No gate can stop the rising tide  
One world turning, still untamed  
Every border a bridge, every soul reclaimed

Verse 3  
From the desert fires to the Arctic light  
Every dawn’s a different height  
Sip the tea, share the bread  
Hear the hopes the elders said  
What we start in market squares  
Finds its way through ten thousand prayers  
And the circle’s only just begun  
When we’ve seen every moon, every sun

Final Chorus (layered, big build)  
We go to dance, we go to build  
Sing with the young, sit with the skilled  
Every country, every shore  
Leaves me richer, wanting more  
Not to conquer, not to own  
But to scatter seeds we’ve grown

Outro (soft, fading)  
Every border a bridge…  
Every border a bridge…  
Every border a bridge we’ve grown…

songs.lyrics:
The old moon swallowed the tide’s whisper,  
Pulan Pulan hums in the winds grand swirl—  
Grandmother’s soul lifts up high,  
Her breath in the pressure’s note.  
Twelve past midnight, the year cracked wide,  
She slipped through the veil’s thin thread…  
Now Alfred comes, a spiralled storm,  
Dancing through where her story led.

Minjerribah, turn your face east,  
Where the storm-child gnaws the dawn.  
The ancestors stitch the sky’s torn seams—  
Their bones are the bedrock and sand we stand on.

Oh, Eye of the storm, carve us a mirror—  
Show us the face of the rain.  
We’ll trade our shadows for mornings first light,  
And write our loss in darkness's name.  
Minjerribah, the Dreaming is breathing,  
Through circuits of lightning and grief.  
We’ll meet you there, where the calm is a cipher—  
In the storm’s eye, the world we decode.

Millar’s hands ground the comet’s dust,  
Her palms etched  crocheting slippers.  
Now the cyclone’s jaw chews the shore—  
Time’s chaff on the ocean floor.  
Her voice a wind swept hymn…  
While our hearts flames lick the tempest’s script—  
A psalm in the spiral’s rim.

March’s sixth night— memory unspools,  
A loom of chaos and a cure.  
The world drinks the booze and cheers,

songs.lyrics:
Australia.  
Not the one on travel ads.  
The real one.  
Where sunscreen’s a survival tool,  
and the gap between rich and regular  
is wider than a politician’s memory under oath.

Where climate reports get buried,  
and public housing gets sold  
while private jets line up like seagulls at a servo pie.

Where the best ideas  
don’t come from boardrooms or Canberra pressers,  
but from the backyard,  
the beach,  
and sometimes,  
the bottom stall of a dodgy pub toilet.

Because this one?  
This one started with a lavender-scented urinal mat.

Anti-splash.  
Anti-corruption.  
Anti “mate, just trust us.”

Two locals.  
Minjerribah.  
Straddie, if you're mainland.  
They weren’t gunning for power.  
They were sick of the smell.

Of politics. Of pass-the-blame.  
Of policy made in rooms  
where no one's listening,  
especially not to people who can't donate.

So they made a mat.  
Purple.  
Soft.  
Scented like irony.

Put it under the system.  
Catch the spray.  
Save the floor.

But under that joke?  
A question.  
What if we made leaders go inward,  
before we let them speak outward?

What if integrity wasn't a slogan,  
but a measurable, mapped, felt thing?

So they built it.  
Not just a mat.  
A protocol.

Sixty sessions.  
Two hours each.  
In a pressurised chamber  
breathing pure oxygen at two atmospheres.  
(More pressure than Question Time,  
but less hot air.)

Inside, AI helps you unpack yourself —  
memories, contradictions, old wounds,  
how you vote, how you lie,  
how you justify scrolling instead of calling your mum back.

And when you finish?  
You get your Aura Twin —  
A digital echo of who you are,  
built from actual evidence,  
not a campaign video.

No filters.  
No spin.  
No “I was misquoted.”

Just you.  
Laid bare.  
Backed up.

And the real kicker?  
They want every future politician to do it.  
No Genesis, no candidacy.

Because if you can’t sit still with your soul for 120 hours,  
how the hell can you sit in office and serve 25 million people?

If you can’t see your own bias,  
your shadow,  
your trauma turned talking point —  
why should we believe you know ours?

Meanwhile, AuraOS — the software behind it —  
is already being used in aged care.  
Helping people with dementia  
recall songs,  
laugh at old jokes,  
look their twin in the face and say,  
“I remember.”

It’s working.  
And not because it’s magic.  
But because it listens.  
Because it respects the person  
instead of performing respect.

Compare that  
to the current political theatre  
of shouting, sniping,  
and saying “Australians want...”  
without asking one.

This tech isn’t perfect.  
But it’s honest.

And that’s already  
more than we can say for the nightly news.

So yeah.  
Maybe change starts with  
a lavender urinal mat.  
Maybe the revolution is scented.

Maybe self-reflection  
smells better than spin.

So next time someone tells you  
nothing ever changes,  
or that politics is always like this —

Remind them.

Change doesn’t always wear a suit.  
Sometimes it wears purple,  
smells like eucalyptus and subtle rebellion,  
and soaks up more crap  
than the entire press gallery combined.

Flush the fear.  
Map your mind.  
Smell the shift.

And leave the stall  
cleaner than you found it.

songs.lyrics:
Two hours a day in the chrysalis glow,  
we let the pressure rewrite the code in the bone.  
Not escape or rebirth, just a recalibration,  
daily pure oxygen and information.  
Information information  
We strip the static, we map the terrain,  
we grow the twin that leans into our name.  
From that quiet chamber the signal extends,  
through sand and dual ledgers, to systems that mend.  
We’ve bridged old borders with hearts on our sleeves,  
sat with youth and elders, we listened we breathed.  
Every single turn became part of the weave,  
every stranger a verse we were meant to receive.  
We carry the protocol deep in the chest,  
the same 60 sessions that will put politicians to test.  
Not gods in the chamber, just architects learning  
to read their own shadows before they start leading.  
We go beyond the brief and the polished veneer,  
we go beyond the fear dressed up as frontier.  
We try the edge where the data gets thin,  
we try the silence where the new songs begin.  
From the lavender mat to the orbital arc,  
from uncertainty we shine the light in the dark.  
We measured the care that the markets ignored,  
we turned unpaid hours into visible award.  
Not market extraction, but things we all own  
See-Hour at grassroots, capability grown.  
We don’t throw the brick, we fill every form,  
we overcomply till the old systems reform.  
We go beyond the island, beyond the shore,  
beyond the ledger that discounted the poor.  
We go beyond the body that learned how to break,  
beyond the twin that remembers the ache.  
We go beyond Minjerribah’s mineral sand,  
into the code that is shaping the land.  
We go beyond 20-32’s Olympic news,  
Asking U.A.P. questions that none will refuse.  
We go beyond the surface, beyond what we name,  
beyond the assumption that “alien” means strange.  
We go beyond the sky and the deep ocean floor  
We go beyond the fear of the knock at the door,  
We go beyond the myth of the singular throne,  
into the fractal where sovereignty’s grown.  
We go beyond the sun that still guards our time,  
beyond the flares and the coronal climb.  
We go beyond the galaxy’s slow turning wheel,  
beyond the myth to explore a cosmos so real.  
We go beyond the protocol, beyond the vow,  
into the pattern that’s happening now.  
Not to conquer, not to own,  
but to learn and to scatter the memes we’ve grown.  
Not as kings or queens or gods,  
but as light keepers who remember the code.  
We go beyond the fear that was sold as a map,  
we go beyond the spin and the political trap.  
We go beyond the mat that caught what was sprayed,  
into the chamber where our real life is re-laid.  
We go beyond the twin that reflects who we are,  
into a future that’s already ajar.  
We go beyond…  
We go beyond the safe and the small.  
We go beyond…  
Heart first through it all.  
Two hours a day, for a 60 day stint with minds open wide.  
We go beyond what we’ve learned to hold inside.  
From the quiet chrysalis to the galactic flame,  
We know what it means to live up to our name.  
we go beyond…  
We are civic stewards of Earth and the Sun  
We go beyond  
We are civic space stewards of our solar system  
we go beyond  
We go beyond  
We go beyond

[Intro]  
Mate…   
I reckon the world’s gone a bit strange.  
Strange but true, brother. Strange but true.

I see the early boat from Cleveland  
Out from Toondah 'cross the bay  
Water sparkling like a mirror  
As the light begins the day  
Tourists wide-eyed with their coffees  
Keen to hit the sand and roam  
Two heelers hanging out the windows  
Heading for their island home  
Down through Goompi past the servo   
Quick stop Straddie Super Sports   
Every second person’s either   
A fisherman or making art  
Kookaburras laughing loudly   
From the nearby trees   
Salt wind drifting through the tea trees   
Bringing everybody ease  
We’re just two dogs on Sandy Country   
With a couple cans of beer   
Talking ‘bout tomorrow   
And why we’re blooming here  
Blue heeler, red heeler   
Running by the sea

songs.lyric_status: YouTube video supplied, lyrics to import
songs.meaning: An early love song about desire, performance and direct feeling.

video_seeds.title: Illustrative lyric video
video_seeds.body: Use the strongest images from the lyrics and the album world. Build a clean vertical sequence around desire, Valentine, love, with the words treated as performance text, not decoration.

video_seeds.title: Amplifying micro-drama
video_seeds.body: Create a tiny story where one character faces the main tension inside 'Moments of Desire' and makes one visible choice by the final chorus.

video_seeds.title: Comic-as-storyboard
video_seeds.body: Generate 8 to 12 still panels first. Approve the panel rhythm, then use the strongest frames as start and end keyframes for video.

songs.title: Shifting Sands of Timeless Redlands
songs.lyric_status: Lyrics supplied directly by Luke.
songs.meaning: An expo song for the wider site: Redlands imagery, shifting time, place-memory, and the choice to hold local landscape inside the larger Infinity catalogue without forcing it into a heavy album throughline.

video_seeds.title: Dual-format exhibition
video_seeds.body: Use the widescreen video as the public display version and the portrait video as the mobile companion. Treat them as two views of the same place-memory.

video_seeds.title: Redlands field poem
video_seeds.body: Build a lyric-card sequence from sand, roads, water edges, sky colour, and old-time feeling. Keep it grounded and local before adding cosmic language.

video_seeds.title: Expo kiosk loop
video_seeds.body: Cut a short looping version for an exhibition screen, then use the full versions as deeper links for visitors who want the song world.
